methods.name: Saliency feature enhancement technique
methods.summary: A semi-automated landslide detection framework that enhances potential landslide pixels using symmetric surround saliency, removes background using slope thresholds, applies morphological operations to refine objects, and classifies landslide scars using the Fuzzy C-means (FCM) clustering algorithm.
methods.verbatim: This study proposes a new landslide detection technique that is semi-automated and based on a saliency enhancement approach.

reproducibility_assessment: The landslide inventory and other input datasets are mentioned but not linked or made available. The custom code used for the saliency feature enhancement technique is not provided or linked.
